To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) generalized inter-transaction association mining is a new and interesting problem in data mining; (2) it is an extension of the traditional association rule mining; (3) it is an important application of data mining; (4) a new algorithm is developed to solve the problem; and (5) the algorithm is implemented and tested with both synthetic and real-life data sets, and the experimental results are encouraging.

the generalized inter- transactional association rules are able to represent a wider scope of association relationships than the traditional intra- transactional association rule and the inter- transactional rules defined in [ACM Transactions on Information Systems 18(4), 2000, p. 423; Proc of the ACM SIG- MOD Workshop on Research Issues in Data Mining and Knowledge Dis- covery, 1998, Seattle, Washington].

(1) The multidimensional inter-relationship mining problem is an extension of the traditional association rule mining problem; (2) A generalized multidimensional inter-transational association rule is a multidimensional association rule which is generalized from a set of multidimensional inter-transitional association rules; (3) An algorithm is proposed to mine such generalized multidimensional intertransactional association rules by extending a priori; and (4) Empirical evaluation shows the algorithm is feasible and effective.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following two aspects: (1) to extend the scope of association rule mining to multidimensional intertransactional association mining, and (2) to extend the definition of inter-transactional rules to generalized inter- transactional association rules.

how to mine multidimensional inter- transactional association rules from data sets, and how to represent and discover more comprehensive association relationships from data.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the generalized multidimensional intertransactional association rules are more general and more comprehensive than the multidimensional intra-transactional and inter-transactional ones.
our algorithm can be applied to a wide range of multidimensional data sets to extract interesting and useful association rules, which can be used for multidimensional data mining.
the generalized inter- transactional association rule is a more general and more powerful tool than the traditional intra- transactional association rules.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we present a new type of multidimensional association rules, which are more general than traditional association rules and can be used in a wider range of applications, and a novel algorithm for mining such rules.

the mining of generalized multidimensional intertransactional association rules provides a new perspective for data mining and knowledge discovery.
